_meta.purpose: §WALK-1.5 geocode gazetteer for the ~211 nodes not in the GEO2 lat/lon table.

schema.realPlaces: code -> {lat, lon}  — authoritative coords; projected like GEO2
schema.satellites: code -> parentCode  — co-locate on parent's cell (locale list, §2.2)
schema.anchors: code -> {anchor, lat, lon, why}  — fantasy/myth/meta with no real coord; lat/lon is an approximate anchor near the entry-quest city; review against quest context
schema.offEarth: code -> {anchor}  — no Earth coord at all (Asgard, math/cosmic); becomes a sub-location of the anchor cell (§3.5.6)

_meta.note: Coords are city/site-level — accuracy is fine at 1° (~110 km/cell). 'anchors' and 'offEarth' are flagged for review; 'realPlaces' and 'satellites' are high-confidence.
